shared-tool-onboarding-pool.title: Connect a shared tool
shared-tool-onboarding-pool.project_rest: You can prepare configuration for this approved shared scope. Your account cannot read the project, so a project return link is not offered.
shared-tool-onboarding-pool.boundary: Prepare this project's shared connection only. This does not create a tool profile, start the runner or enable a tool. Explicitly run the prepared configuration on the target machine, then check its new complete inventory.
